Windows Update Profile

Choose how Windows handles updates on this system.

Default

Default Windows Update Configuration

  • No modifications to Windows defaults
  • Removes any custom update settings

Note: this resets your Windows Update settings to out-of-the-box. It removes ANY policy or customization applied to Windows Update.

Recommended

Balanced Security Configuration

  • Feature updates delayed by 365 days
  • Security updates installed after 4 days
  • Prevents Windows Update from installing drivers

Feature UpdatesNew features and potential bugs

Security UpdatesCritical security patches

Note: this only applies to Pro systems that can use group policy.

High Risk

Not Recommended

  • Disables ALL Windows Updates
  • Increases security risks
  • Only use for isolated systems
